oscillator.fingerprint_policy: SHA-256 of model.js decoded as UTF-8, CRLF/CR normalized to LF, then UTF-8 encoded; no other rewriting.

reference.sample_selection: nearest native sample by round(t * sampleRate), limited to the last stored sample while t < duration

equations.channels: native retained PCM samples; no inferred physical stress or categorical waveform

alignment.outside_source_support: missing; no cyclic source extension or extrapolation

transport.clock_role: shared display cursor; loop changes only cursor position, never source support
transport.persistence_role: rendered trailing history span, not dynamical damping

audio.role: audition request only; this pure module never starts audio or playback

discrepancy.window_policy: caller-specified half-open [start,end), sampled on the display clock grid
discrepancy.missing_policy: exclude missing pairs from error statistics; include them explicitly in coverage
discrepancy.claim: Pointwise channel discrepancy on the selected window only; not whole-system equivalence.

form.authority: Retained native values and units remain authoritative; this is an explicit display mapping, not physical geometry or newly inferred information.
form.shared_calibration: Both series use the same ordered channels, positive scales, contribution formula, mesh, coordinates, projection and camera.
form.contribution: q_i = tanh(native_value_i / shared_scale_i); signed, bounded display compression only. Native values remain unchanged and inspectable.
form.omissions: Unselected channels are not encoded; no source fields are deleted. The surface does not encode source uncertainty, density, probability or an inferred lifecycle.

geometry.formula: r(n) = 1.2 * (1 + 0.32 * sum_i(q_i * exp(4 * (dot(n, direction_i) - 1)))); point = [r*n_x, r*n_y, 2.2 + r*n_z]
geometry.topology: One closed shell with unique poles, periodic longitude and no mirrored second signal; tessellated display surface.
geometry.baseline: Radius 1.2 at zero contributions, centered 2.2 display units above the reference plane.
geometry.sign: Positive values produce a bulge; negative values produce an indentation in the same fixed channel direction.

projection.rotation: yaw about vertical followed by elevation pitch
projection.viewport_capture: Runtime canvas dimensions affect presentation only; no automatic recalibration or analysis.

form.trail: Optional retained frames rendered independently as faint wire contours. No interpolated temporal observations.

history.policy: 2 retained B frames; no time averaging

signal.rendering: CSS-pixel plot; synthetic equations sampled for display; music uses native PCM min/max bins per pixel; no invented intermediate PCM samples
signal.selection: One shared display time; candidate native time = display time − shift

audio.source: retained stereo PCM after declared candidate alignment
audio.playback: same display cursor/speed/loop; 20 Hz highpass removes DC; master gain .35; mix both averages A and B; clipping to [-1,1] at playback only

renderingRecord.capture: No viewport or historical pixel captures are asserted as replay-validated facts.

base.replayPolicy: State and transformations are checked against this implementation and the complete supplied source fingerprint manifest. Restoring expresses requested playback/audio state; it never starts either.

checks.name: Zero contributions give one closed baseline shell above the reference plane

Both encodings use the same two signed contributions under shared calibration
Missing channels, invalid scales and unsupported cameras are rejected
Camera, viewport and labels affect presentation only; picks bind exact native values

result.scope: Closed-mesh topology, finite display geometry, source-value binding, shared calibration and camera invariance. Browser inspection is separately required.

results.name: Selected source copies and the separate template match their recorded exact-byte hashes
Every selected entity and lookup retains every native field, empty value, label and ordering
Every relationship and source mapping resolves to its exact retained native record and field
Coverage distinguishes explicit aggregates, missing metadata and native unclassified labels
Only capture timestamps are exposed; catalogue classifications are never represented as a sampled signal
SCM invalid-query and historical-fingerprint issues remain distinct from zero results and measurements
MM lake remains a template-only entry, without attributing any demonstration music to it

result.scope: Exact copied bytes, complete native field retention, recorded relationship references, coverage and metadata/measurement boundaries. External originals absent on another machine remain unavailable, not verified.
Pure model, exact source selection, bounded discrepancy and session contracts; not browser or audio acceptance.

results.name: Default state is complete and independently copied
Fixed reference matches known sinusoid extrema and does not change under candidate edits
Candidate analytical velocity agrees with an independent finite difference
Align changes observation time/value, preserving candidate recipe and derivative semantics
Transport looping does not invent source support; missing overlap is counted
Exact generated match has zero pointwise discrepancy over the declared half-open window
PCM selection is nearest stored sample, with index, quantization and exact source reference
Music Tune is unapplied; B alignment maps both channels and metrics use native sampling
Native-rate PCM discrepancy matches hand-computed shifted/gained sample pairs
PCM missingness and invalid sampling are explicit; lake records do not become waveforms
Deep validation rejects extra fields, coercion, impossible bounds, unsupported stretching and excess alternatives
Whole saved interaction state and generated alternatives restore without triggering playback or audio
Contribution selection is source-appropriate and disclosure state is strict
Restore rejects altered transformation/source/rendering receipts and never trusts a supplied capture

assembly.newline_policy: UTF-8 without BOM; template/code CRLF and CR become LF; binary HTML output; raw evidence bytes and fingerprints unchanged.
assembly.model_fingerprint_policy: SHA-256 of model.js decoded as UTF-8, CRLF/CR normalized to LF, then UTF-8 encoded; no other rewriting.
assembly.scope: Exact executable bytes and binary output; all code/data/audio embedded. Accepted-baseline and evidence hyperlinks open separately on user action.

music.scope: Retained PCM header/data/hash and supplied annotation bounds, order, coverage and generator fingerprint. Audibility and browser transport are separate.

accepted_baseline.scope: Read-only comparison to the retained accepted release manifest and custody record.

content.scope: Observatory contracts, exact offline assembly, supplied stereo music and immutable accepted baseline. Browser interaction/audio and visual usability are separately evidenced.

facts.snapshot_policy: Frozen verify.py input_snapshot(): exact file bytes; report/package records, archives, logs and pycache excluded.
omissions: No receipt signature or trusted issuer is checked by the frozen package gate.
No workers/service-rate control exists in this target.
Runtime failure, concurrent external changes and arbitrary new code/data revisions are outside this bounded selector.

roleGraph.scope: No queue-time or service-rate value is mapped onto package execution.
